obligation: G032 -- does the channel-scale win survive a CONSISTENT fold across the whole MLP block?
why: The per-tensor measurement scaled one tensor at a time. A deployable fold changes three tensors at once: s on the hidden axis folds into input_layernorm, t on the intermediate axis folds into up_proj's OUTPUT rows, so up_proj is scaled on BOTH axes and its own quantization error changes. Only the block-level number is the real one.
fold_algebra: gate' = Wg diag(s); up' = diag(1/t) Wu diag(s); down' = Wd diag(t); x' = x/s. Then gate'x' = gate, up'x' = up/t, h' = h/t, down'h' = down h. EXACT, zero runtime change and zero extra storage -- diag(1/s) folds into the RMSNorm weight and diag(1/t) into up_proj rows.
scales_fitted_on: head slice of the capture; block scored on the disjoint tail slice
